newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips fall with focus on impact of slowing economy.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips fall with focus on impact of slowing economy.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed lower Wednesday as the market's focus shifted to the impact that a slowing economy could have on future corporate earnings.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended 13.79 points lower at 5,993.23 after gaining more than 20 points earlier in the day.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a small margin on active volume of 441 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
